## Methodology

The Economist’s model of America’s congressional elections estimates both major parties’ chances of winning each House and Senate race, and of controlling each legislative chamber. The forecast combines national and race-level polls from FiftyPlusOne with fundamental data about past electoral results and the nominees in each contest, in order to estimate the probability of each possible outcome. [...] The model does this by first constructing 25,001 hypothetical scenarios for the national popular vote for the House of Representatives.
